jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: you will be responsible for the delivery of analytics and insights solutions to solve business problems using data science techniques. You must be able to demonstrate an ability to understand business challenges and develop insight-driven analytical solutions for decision making, leveraging combination skills across data engineering, data science, business insights and stakeholder management to create customer and commercially focused outcomes. You will execute analytics activities to drive business benefit and customer experience, including data wrangling, predictive modelling, clustering, text mining, data visualisation, simulation and optimisation. Candidates should be educated to minimum degree level or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Engineering or other numerate related discipline, with 3+ years work experience in an analytics role and hands-on experience training machine learning models. Strong coding skills using SQL, Python (or R) and SAS are required, along with demonstrated ability to use tools such as Power BI, Datorama, Tableau or Qlik for data visualisation and insights presentation. This position is only open to Australian or New Zealand Permanent Residents or Citizens.

jobs.title: AI Agent 研发实习生（2026届）
jobs.description: AI Agent R&D Intern (2026届) at Transsion Holdings, requiring students majoring in computer science, AI, mathematics, or automation. Key requirements include proficiency in Python programming, understanding of major large language models (GPT-4, Claude 3.5, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.), and familiarity with at least one Agent development framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGPT. Preferred qualifications include graduate-level research in NLP, multimodal learning, or reinforcement learning, personal open-source AI projects or contributions to mainstream frameworks on GitHub, experience with vector databases like Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate, and Docker containerization skills. The internship requires at least 3 days per week for 6+ months, with on-site work in Shenzhen. Responsibilities include Agent architecture design, prompt optimization, multimodal tool integration, RAG solution implementation, and performance evaluation.
